snippet.title: Warframe - Official 'The Old Peace' Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out 'The Old Peace' Announcement Trailer for Warframe, the hit free-to-play multiplayer third-person action shooter developed by Digital Extremes. Players can get a look at the new upcoming update taking players on a journey through distant memories of The Old War, a profound and ancient conflict between the Orokin and their Sentient creations in the far-flung system of Tau. Set during a fragile period of calm, The Old Peace will see your remastered Operator traversing the battlefields of Perita as you uncover the hostilities that threaten to unravel a vitally important truce. 

Warframe fans can also look forward to a new quest surrounding The Teacher, the 62nd Warframe yet to be revealed, an Oberon Rework packed with a touch-up to his abilities and improvements, and more. The Old Peace Update for Warframe is launching Fall 2025 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android, and PC.
